summary: A generative drone firmware built on Felucca: one button rolls an ambient arrangement in a shared key, with pad, sequence and chord arpeggio parts under a fourth voice you play. Marked experimental.
features: 'Immaculate Permutation' rolls pad, sequence and arpeggio parts
Minor, Dorian and pentatonic scales; slow, ambient-leaning presets
Automatic evolution every 2 to 32 bars, or by hand
Hold SAVE to keep a session in project slots A to D; undo last change
Full Felucca instrument editor and a macro page while it plays
Saves can't be read by older Felucca or Jangada firmware

headings: fm-1 unholy union generative drone firmware
